video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Post Game vs New York Knicks | November 15, 2026

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on late-game execution and defensive discipline
quotes.excerpt: we had three or four straight possessions that we did not execute our coverages
quotes.quote: We had three or four straight possessions that we did not execute our coverages that we were supposed to do, what we were doing the whole game. We just lost discipline there for a couple of possessions and that gave them life. I thought we had a game under control. We did a really good job defensively for the biggest part of the game, but that little stretch there gave them life.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on the Raptors current struggles: We are right now in the mud, and the only way we get out of this is to continue to improve, continue to work, continue to put a fight in.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic explains the team's failure to execute defensive coverages during a critical late-game stretch.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on poor three-point shooting and missed opportunities
quotes.excerpt: we were shooting the ball from three-point line 31 percent. We missed several layups
quotes.quote: We were shooting the ball from three-point line 31 percent. We missed several layups, we missed some wide-open shots, missed a couple of free throws there as well. All of that adds up, but overall I think we were getting pretty good looks for the biggest part of the game, but the ball did not go through the net when we needed it.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on late game execution: We had three or four straight possessions that we did not execute our coverages that we were supposed to do. We just lost discipline there for a couple of possessions and that gave them life.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic discusses the team's poor shooting performance and missed opportunities throughout the game.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on the team's current struggles and path forward
quotes.excerpt: when the wheel gets in the mud, the wheel is going to get out of the mud
quotes.quote: In my country in Serbia, we have a saying: when the wheel gets in the mud, the wheel is going to get out of the mud. We are right now in the mud, and the only way we get out of this is to continue to improve, continue to work, continue to put a fight in, continue to watch film, to analyze, to have honest conversations, and we are in this together. We are going to figure it out, no doubt about that.
quotes.social_post: Immanuel Quickley on the Raptors late game struggles: We had a lot of mental errors just at the end of the game. I think we played maybe 45 to 44 minutes of great basketball. We just got to put it together and make it 48.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic uses a metaphor to describe the team's current struggles and emphasizes the need for collective improvement.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Immanuel Quickley's impact and team rotation
quotes.excerpt: we were going into more switching from the start of the game and Immanuel Quickley is really good
quotes.quote: We were going into more switching from the start of the game and Immanuel Quickley is really good with that as a switching partner with the rest of the guys there. I thought Scottie Barnes brought us really good minutes off the bench there. He played really well with the second unit. We are just trying to find a winning formula for our team, and what happened tonight does not mean it is going to be the same next game.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes on his return to the court: Honestly the way my body feels now, it is kind of really the best I felt all season to be honest. So I felt great.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic discusses his rotation strategy and the defensive impact of Immanuel Quickley and Scottie Barnes.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on managing Scottie Barnes' return minutes
quotes.excerpt: we were keeping Scottie Barnes on the bench longer stints, we wanted to save him as much as possible
quotes.quote: Yes, we were keeping Scottie Barnes on the bench longer stints, we wanted to save him as much as possible with the first game coming back, but overtime trapped all of that.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes on the Raptors offensive identity: We just got to stop trying to kind of plan to secure the win. Keep playing fast, keep running random actions, keep getting some ball movement.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic explains the decision to limit Scottie Barnes' minutes in his first game back from injury.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on Scottie Barnes' performance in his return
quotes.excerpt: I think he had a really good game. He opened up with a lot of energy
quotes.quote: I think he had a really good game. I think he opened up with a lot of energy, gave us a lot of boost there. I thought that he competed the whole game.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes on his defensive mindset: I know I am one of the best defenders in this league and you know I can feel I can guard anybody. Do what I do out there on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajakovic
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajakovic on team flexibility and closing lineups
quotes.excerpt: we have a team that is flexible and the guys understand that we are trying to win
quotes.quote: A lot of times the end of the game is just reading the game. It is getting the matchups, it is depending on do we need more offense or different matchup, who is on the court for them. We have a team that is flexible and the guys understand that we are trying to win games and try to find winning formula there for us. So we are not going to shy away from trying different guys and I don't see any bad in that.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic on rotation flexibility: We are not going to shy away from trying different guys and I don't see any bad in that.

structured.context: Darko Rajakovic explains the team's flexible approach to closing lineups and game-specific matchups.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on the importance of learning from close losses
quotes.excerpt: if anything is evident from last year is that we learn as we go
quotes.quote: If anything is evident from last year is that we learn as we go. I think we had a lot of these mistakes and a lot of these moments last year when we were getting used to playing with each other and doing these things at a high level at the end of games again. Having Scottie Barnes back today was a little different, and then you know if you add Kawhi Leonard in that mix, it is just we just got to get better at the end of games, and I think having these moments does nothing but good for us.

quotes.speaker: Jamal Shead
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamal Shead on moving on to the next game
quotes.excerpt: I think you put together 48 minutes and there is a tie, those 48 minutes don't matter anymore
quotes.quote: I think you put together 48 minutes and there is a tie, those 48 minutes don't matter anymore. We went into overtime with a 0-0 mentality. Darko Rajakovic preaches this all the time, and we just lost those last five minutes. So I think if we win those five minutes, we are having a different conversation about the whole game and our mistakes, but we just got to figure out a way to win the game.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes on late game mistakes: We got to come over to a big-time rebound, got a five-second call. Those are two terrible mistakes that we just got to have in that game.

quotes.quote: We just got to stop trying to kind of plan to secure the win. Keep playing fast, keep running random actions, keep getting some ball movement.
